title: Remote ABACUS was months behind master_ghj and missed the atom-mapping/Bloch-phase symmetry fix
symptom: A remote MnTe run used ABACUS 7e40c5bb (Aug 23) while master_ghj was b6a432b9; the missing e0407be4 fixes atom-mapping direction and Bloch phase when restoring density/Green functions from irreducible k - and 6 of 12 MnTe symmetry operations swap the two Te atoms.
root_cause: Remote build directories drift from the pinned baseline; the version guard must compare against the profile-pinned revision, not 'whatever is installed'.
minimal_fix: Rebuild remote ABACUS at the pinned commit and rerun; treat the rebuild as necessary but not sufficient - after rebuilding to b6a432b9 the MnTe GW still showed -23964..-8351 eV states, so other causes (see mnte open entry) remained.
validation: Rebuilt binary passes its test suite; rerun recorded under a new attempt id.
avoid: Assuming the remote build is current because the path name says so.

parameters.rule: rebuild remote at profile-pinned commit; rebuild is necessary, not sufficient
